plain_english_policy: Maintaining the operational readiness of troops and equipment (e.g., training, maintenance, repairs).
evidence_quote: *'Ensure that our military personnel are fully trained and equipped to meet current and emerging threats by prioritizing troop readiness and modernizing defense infrastructure.*'
review_reason: Readiness policies often involve both progressive (equity in veteran care) and conservative (national security priorities) elements, but this option is procedurally neutral. Context matters: e.g., funding cuts could be framed as fiscal conservatism or budgetary austerity.
